g.text: The displacement peak occurs below r=1 when damping is positive and sufficiently small

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Same forced-displacement magnification convention as1274. The positive-frequency peak condition differs from merely settingω=ωn. Forζ≥1/√2 the maximum over
r≥0 is at r0, M1. Curves are ideal linear-response functions, not machine operating limits or measured modal data.
